note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Elegg is an MG/Electric/Supporter/Burst II whose whole damage kit keys off a self-inflicted enemy status: her burst opens a 10 s 'BOOM Install' window (modeled as a name-keyed targetStatus), and BOTH rider lines (S1 100-hit distributed nuke, S2 60-hit team ATK grant) are gated on the boss carrying that status, so they can only fire inside those windows. S2's second line is a battery-opening 100% burst-gauge fill, modeled as a battle-start passive (once-per-battle). Her S1 anti-projectile buff and her burst's enemy DEF ▼ are recorded but unmodeled — neither has a channel in the current effect schema (no enemy projectiles in v1; no enemy-DEF StatKey). Distributed-damage flavor is used on the S1 rider so her own burst's distributedDamagePct buff feeds it.

skill1: When attacking an enemy projectile, damage dealt to that projectile ▲ 59.66% continuously.

caveats: ⚑ S1 GATE READING: 'Affects the target and 2 surrounding enemy unit(s) if the target is in BOOM Install' is parsed LITERALLY — the if-clause gates the whole activation, so the 158.65% distributed rider fires only while BOOM Install is live (requiresTargetStatus). Alternate reading: the rider always hits the primary target and BOOM Install merely ADDS the 2-enemy spread. On the partless single-target scope-lock boss the two readings differ only in HOW OFTEN the rider fires — a large damage delta. UNMEASURED.

⚑ DISTRIBUTED SPLIT-vs-MERGE: 158.65% is modeled as landing in FULL on the single boss. If Distributed Damage divides the stated total across the 'target + 2 surrounding' target set even when fewer enemies exist, the true per-hit value is ~1/3. Kit-silent; popup-read required.

⚑ BURST-GAUGE FILL: the once-per-battle 100% fill is keyed to a `passive` trigger (the schema's battle-start channel). This is load-bearing for the whole rotation — if the engine re-applies passive-block effects rather than resolving them once at setup, this grants unbounded gauge. Verify one fillGauge application at frame 0, then never again.

⚑ ENEMY DEF ▼ 35.64% (10 s) is UNMODELED: the effect schema has no enemy-DEF channel ('defPct' is documented self-scoped and inert; 'damageTakenPct' is a different bucket and would over-credit). The 10 s BOOM Install WINDOW is modeled (targetStatus) because the S1/S2 gates depend on it — only the DEF magnitude is dropped. This under-credits the team's damage inside her burst window by whatever the boss-DEF term is worth.

⚑ CADENCE: hitCount thresholds of 100 (S1) and 60 (S2) convert to wall-clock via the MG pull rate / 300-round belt / 171-frame reload — all datamine-unreliable fields. Rider frequency, hence her whole contribution, scales directly with that tuple.
S1 anti-projectile buff (59.66%) is inert by scope: v1 models no enemy projectiles and the scope-lock boss offers no shootable projectile. Recorded, not skipped for convenience.

Burst-cast damage (316.66%) carries no `noFb` — it is FB-exempt by CAST TIMING (the cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens), which the engine handles; setting noFb would be an unmeasured per-kit override.
Crit eligibility of both damage lines is left to the engine default (flat-damage rider crit is an engine-global policy, not a kit-stated property of this unit).
